		monthly_agricultural_tax = resource_tier_4_main_income
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_agricultural_tax = resource_tier_4_main_income_tribal
	}

				trade_good_horses_production_mult = horse_studfarm_horse_mult_per_grain_need

			}
		}
	}

	}

		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_horses CATEGORY = trade_category_beasts_of_burden }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_grain CATEGORY = trade_category_cereals }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_category_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_horses CATEGORY = trade_category_beasts_of_burden }
		ai_resource_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 4 }
	}
}
